name: Gyaku Saimin Omoikiri Boku o Aishite Ijimete Kawaigatte
original_name: 逆催眠 思い切り僕を愛して苛めて可愛がって
source:
The protagonist, a college student, has a secret that he can't tell anyone.
It is that he is a very masochistic man!

Whenever he saw a woman he liked, he spent his days in agony, thinking, "I want her to torment me...."

However, a chance encounter changed his peaceful days.

He happened to stop by a used bookstore and found a book, titled "Hypnotism for Anyone". 

Despite believing that it would never work, he tried it with his friends and found it to be more effective than expected. Still, it was no more than a fun joke, something to be played with for fun.

Then one day, the protagonist sees a woman he likes in town and, just as usual, he thinks to himself, "I wish she would torment me."

Then suddenly, a thought comes to his mind.

"Wait a minute, what would happen if I hypnotized her?"

Wouldn't his M fantasy of wanting a woman to torment him become a reality?
Although he couldn't do anything at that moment, the protagonist has been thinking about it in agony ever since.

Finally, one day, he hypnotizes an unknown woman!
Thereafter, he hypnotizes women one after another, and is adored, loved, and tormented by them.

His dreamlike "reverse hypnotism" life, how does it end?

[translated from [url=http://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/gyakusai1/story.html]official website[/url]]
